value:
The Tarn Union has officially opened a new trading post along the river road. It is another expansion for the Outlanders, providing a fresh stop for anyone with enough credits to spare. They are moving in, and the road is getting busier by the day.

Looking toward the northern hills, the forecast indicates a biting cold snap is on the horizon. It won't be pleasant for those caught out in the open, so if you have a coat, you might want to keep it within reach. 

The Rim remains as restless as ever, but these are the only whispers worth sharing today. Keep your eyes open and your boots dry; the weather has a way of turning sour before you know it.

attempts.text:
The Tarn Union has established a new trading post along the river road. If you’re looking to swap scraps for something useful, that’s your new destination. 

On a less profitable note, a cold snap is forecast for the northern hills. It’s going to be a miserable stretch for anyone foolish enough to be caught out in the open without proper gear. Expect the frost to bite.
